description: Search across every parsed line item the user has uploaded (case-insensitive substring on description + normalized description). Returns matching items, total count, and aggregate spend grouped by currency. Optional `category`, `startDate`, and `endDate` further narrow the window. Use this for questions like 'how much did I spend on cappuccinos this year?'.

category.description: Restrict to a line-item category id (e.g. 'food_dairy').

endDate.description: ISO date — items from receipts dated on/before.

limit.description: Page size for the items array (default 50, max 200).

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

query.description: Free-text query (>= 2 chars). Matched against item description.

startDate.description: ISO date — items from receipts dated on/after.

name: search_receipt_line_items
